verdicts.reason: A: the can is shrunk to a tiny icon and the 'Find a Store' button is very small, so the product loses its meaning and the CTA almost disappears. Both sit cramped at the bottom above a big empty middle, and the SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline instead of leading. B: the CTA is placed above the headline, which breaks the reading order and crowds the top. The body line runs nearly edge to edge at a tiny size, and the wordmark still sits below the headline. B keeps the can at a readable size and the button stays legible, so it is the less broken of the two.
